pm_mas_yr.source: SIMBAD V* RW Aur (pmra = mu_alpha * cos(delta), pmdec)

radius_rsun.source: not available: Gaia DR3 has no FLAME radius for this star; no interferometric radius is in the literature registry, and a spectral-class table is never used for a radius (Q-152)

teff_K.formula: median of the non-null Teff values in SIMBAD mesFe_h; of two middle values, the one from the most recent bibcode (Q-152)
teff_K.source: SIMBAD mesFe_h: median of 1 published spectroscopic Teff values (3885 to 3885 K); the middle value is from 2021ApJ...921...53L

render_params.alt_text: V* RW Aur, T Tauri star, size unknown, colour from Teff, self-luminous. Surface relief: illustrative.

confidence.formula: C = sum(w_i c_i) / sum(w_i): c is 1 for a measured value or a formula of measured values, a placeholder share for a model-dependent one, and 0 for an assumed, artistic or missing one; the w_i are placeholder weights (D-36, Q-221)
confidence.found: Data for: Temperature and colour, spectral class or motion on the sky.
confidence.note: This is how much of the picture rests on data. It is not the probability that the picture is correct.
confidence.weights_note: Placeholder weights: they come from the approved prototype until a sensitivity sweep replaces them (D-36).

layers.description: Teff to sRGB through a blackbody colour calculation (R7.5).
layers.formula: Planck(Teff) integrated 380-780 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit), XYZ -> linear sRGB (D65), clipped at 0, brightest channel = 1 (R7.5)

layers.description: Assumption: linear limb darkening, I(mu) = 1 - 0.6 * (1 - mu) (R7.5).
A flared disc lit by the star, tilted 45 to 60 degrees (R7.5). Its shape and brightness are artistic.

rgb.formula: Planck(Teff) integrated 380-780 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit), XYZ -> linear sRGB (D65), clipped at 0, brightest channel = 1 (R7.5)
